description:
Resolve a breakable container's plan document in one function, make every site that needs it call that function, and merge the two plan-content readers into one.

## Background

The chain breakable type → container template with a plan-document location → planning node (`crate::templates::find_planning_node`, `crates/jit/src/templates.rs:658`) → planning node's `plan`-labelled document reference (`planning_node_plan_path`, `:685`) is written three times:

- `plan_document_paths` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:998-1019`) derives the paths a validation capture must read;
- `plan_content_with_issues` (`commands/validate.rs:1056-1102`) reads the content for graph-rule evaluation and serves the mutation callers (`commands/mod.rs:2773,3191`, `commands/dependency.rs:382`, `commands/bulk_update.rs:377`);
- `project_plan_content` (`crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:633-668`) reads the content inside repository validation.

`plan_content_from_image` (`commands/validate.rs:1033-1052`) is a second content reader: it parses the image's issues leniently and forwards to `plan_content_with_issues`. Its callers already hold the issues (`commands/issue.rs:129`, `commands/validate.rs:1155`, `commands/gate_check.rs:458,534`) except `image_plan_content` (`validate.rs:1614-1623`).

The content readers share one rule: an absent plan whose planning node is not `done` is omitted, and an absent plan whose planning node is `done` is an error. The scope-validation tests over external plans (`crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/scope_validation_tests.rs:984-1215,1327,1356`) exercise the rule end to end.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One pure function in `crate::templates` maps a container, the issues by id and the template registry to the container's plan-document reference, or none, together with whether its planning node is `done`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `plan_document_paths`, the plan-content reader and `project_plan_content` obtain plan-document references only through that function; no other code walks from a breakable type to a planning node's plan document.
- [hard] REQ-03: One function reads plan content from an image for given issues; `plan_content_from_image` no longer exists, each of its callers passes the issues it holds, and `image_plan_content` passes the issues its capture holds.
- [hard] REQ-04: One templates unit test owns the resolution cases: an inline plan (no reference), a relinked non-default path, and the not-done and done planning node; the scope-validation suite passes unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: One resolver for plan-document references
